**New Red Cross and Red Crescent operations** (2 to 8 October, as IFRC GO recorded them)
• **Ethiopia**: Ethiopian Red Cross Society. "Ethiopia Drought Response", a DREF allocation of CHF 749,972 to reach 50,000 people, until 31 March 2027. https://go.ifrc.org/countries/65
  Who else works there: 144 organisations in OCHA's latest "who does what where" (January to March 2026), 73 of them national NGOs. The commonest sectors: Protection, Food Security and Education. Source: Ethiopia: Operational Presence, OCHA Ethiopia, via HDX (CC BY), https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ethiopia-operational-presence

**Lifeboats**
RNLI lifeboat crews launched 135 times from 76 stations on the same seven days of 2025 (2 to 8 October), and rendered assistance on 60 of those launches. Busiest: Bembridge and Tower, 7 launches each.

**Listed heroes**
None yet. Hero Watch will carry real-life heroes' own reports once they choose to be listed: after the fact, and never more precisely than a city.

Sources: IFRC GO, the emergency operations data bank of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (https://go.ifrc.org/), used non-commercially. Who does what where: OCHA's operational presence data, through HDX HAPI (hapi.humdata.org), each dataset under the licence named beside it. RNLI Return of Service (https://data-rnli.opendata.arcgis.com). Contains Open Data licensed under the GIS Open Data Licence.
